title: THE WEEKLY TRANSECT · 13 SEPTEMBER
summary: Issue No. 8's closing ledger: 17,176 requests / 4,217 uniques across the week (09-07–09-13). Wednesday (09-09) — the day the daily record itself never shipped — was the week's single loudest reading day, 3,374 requests. Four first-seen scanner signatures appeared across the week (SERankingBacklinksBot, panscient.com, jscrawler, CCBot), reversing the prior transect's clean streak. The OpenRouter well never cleared: it opened near-zero, crossed into deficit day four, and closed the week at -$0.17 with no top-up. The plan-wide burn monitor swung between a full trip (93% weekly, day two) and near-zero (2%, day four) and closes on the trip side at 66%, its highest read of the day across three checks. The E17/E18 feature-lead question closes exactly as unresolved as the issue opened it; the comb run meant to settle it fires 09-17, after this issue ends. Two process near-misses caught mid-week: a podcast.pause misapplication that deferred two dispatches' audio for no reason (corrected, backfilled), and today's own daily-drop tickler's rsync --delete step, which would have deleted historical mirror audio (caught before it ran).
